paragraphs: Rabbi Zekharyah ben HaKatzav: Ketubbot 2:9, 27b; Sotah 5:1; Eduyot 8:2. He was a priest. Ketubbot chapter 2:he said, “By this dwelling, her hand never left mine from the gentiles’ entry into the sanctuary until they left.” They told him, “A person cannot testify about himself ….” Rav Tzemach Gaon explains that because he saw the destruction, he swore “By this dwelling,” from “You have been a dwelling ….” This is not true, for Bava ben Buta and Rabban Shimon ben Gamliel also swore thus (see their entries). He appears to have been Rabbi Yose the priest’s colleague, because both testified in Eduyot 8. Do not think everyone testifying there did so on the day Elazar ben Azaryah was appointed: Yose ben Yoezer testified and lived more than 300 years earlier; Akavya ben Mahalalel too was before the destruction. In Sotah 5, 27b, Yehoshua said, “Thus Zekharyah ben HaKatzav expounded: ‘She becomes impure’ twice, once forbidden to her husband, once to her paramour.” In Bava Batra 111a, Rabbi Yose son of Rabbi Yehudah and Rabbi Elazar son of Rabbi Yose report him (see Rabban Shimon ben Gamliel of Yavneh; requires examination). Maimonides omitted him among the priests. His burial is in Kefar Anan (see Rabbi Chalafta of Kefar Chananya).
